rationale: C08 is a near-direct predecessor to the child: it authorizes inspection of the same categories of tax returns by the same Senate Committee on the Judiciary, under the same Senate Resolution 245, for investigation of the same statute, and subject to the same Treasury-decision conditions. The child updates the terminal tax year from 1951 to 1952, incorporates the later resolution extending the investigation, and slightly revises the description of its purpose. C17 and C23 share the standard tax-return-inspection machinery and close phrasing, but neither matches the child's committee, underlying investigation, and authorizing resolution as C08 does.
